_comment: Copy to mcp-local/config.json (git-ignored; the model's tools cannot write it). It is merged with the built-in policy in guard.py: you can add roots, block more paths, or make a built-in root read-only, but you cannot remove a built-in block. This example makes the whole D:, E: and F: drives read-only and keeps one working folder writable (the most specific root wins). Keys that start with '_' are ignored.
